title: Coin of the Realm: The Crash
description: PigeonCoin is down ninety eight percent. Chad says it's a healthy dip. The pigeons have other plans.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're back on The Truth Hour, Snazzie FM. Last week, we brought you the future of money. PigeonCoin. Tonight... we bring you the aftermath.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The aftermath. I want it on record that I called this, Ronnie.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Nobody is keeping records, Barry.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I am. I have a notebook.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Our man Chad is back to explain what happened to the coin. Chad, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Yo, Ronnie. Okay. First of all? <p:0.3> Everything is fine.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The coin is down ninety eight percent, Chad.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Down is just up that hasn't happened yet, Barry.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that is the kind of optimism this market needs.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: It's a dip, Ronnie. A healthy dip. The pigeons are just... consolidating.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Consolidating where? I heard they left.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: ...They did not leave, Barry. They relocated. Voluntarily.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: A strategic migration.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Exactly. You get it, Ronnie. <p:0.3> The flock is stronger than ever.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: Yeah, I'd like to talk to the kid. <p:0.4> I put my whole pension into PigeonCoin.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Gary! My guy! How's the portfolio?

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: It's a photo of an empty garage, Chad.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: ...That's the cold storage, Gary. Your coins are safe. They're just, you know. Gone.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Gone is the opposite of safe, Chad.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Not in crypto, Barry. Do your research.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I sold my car for forty thousand PigeonCoins. <p:0.3> The app just shows a feather now.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: A feather! See? <p:0.3> That's the loyalty badge, Patricia. That is rare. You should be thrilled.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I am living in the car I sold.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: And yet you still have the feather. There is something beautiful in that.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: There is nothing beautiful in that, Ronnie!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Um, Ronnie? <p:0.3> There are pigeons in the parking lot. <p:0.3> A lot of them. They look... organized.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Organized how, Todd?

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Like they're waiting for something. <p:0.4> One of them has a tiny vest.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: That's my CFO! <p:0.3> Don't make eye contact, Todd, he doesn't like that.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The bird has a vest?! Chad, the bird has a VEST?!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: He EARNED that vest, Barry!

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: I want my pension, kid!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: It's in the bird, Gary! It's all in the bird!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Let's everyone stay calm. The bird has our money. We process that as a community.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: I LIVE IN A CAR!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: And the car is an asset, Patricia! You're basically a landlord now!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, I'm calling someone. I am calling an actual authority.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: You can't stop the flock, Barry! <p:0.3> THE FLOCK IS ETERNAL!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Chad, is there any way for these people to get their money back?

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Totally, Ronnie. They just find the bird, approach slowly, and ask nicely.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ask the bird. Nicely.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: He responds to respect, Barry. And breadcrumbs. But not the battery bread, the good bread.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: I'm seventy one years old. I am not chasing a bird.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Then you forfeit, Gary. Those are the terms. You signed them.

lines.speaker: caller-gary
lines.text: I didn't sign anything!

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: You clicked 'I agree', Gary. The bird saw.

lines.speaker: caller-patricia
lines.text: How does a bird even operate a server farm?

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: Talons, Patricia. <p:0.3> Have you ever really looked at a talon?

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: I have, actually. Off-putting little hands.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: They are feet, Ronnie! They are bird feet!

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: Ronnie, the vest pigeon is at the window. <p:0.3> He's tapping. <p:0.4> I think it's morse code.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: What's he saying, Todd?

lines.speaker: todd
lines.text: I think... it says 'sell'.

lines.speaker: caller-chad
lines.text: DO NOT SELL! <p:0.3> That's a fake CFO, Todd! The real one would never!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We'll be right back. Do not, and I cannot stress this enough... do not invest in the bird.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I'm getting the notebook.
